content: We need to place CO2 on slab at specified site. The add_adsorbate_to_slab_text succeeded when site provided as list [0.5,0.5,0.5] (fractional coordinates). That gave a combined CIF string. We need to save that to a file. The workspace is read-only at /workspace, but we can write to the workdir path. The original inputs are under /Users/n0w0f/.../workdir/5/... So we should write the output file somewhere we have write permission, likely same directory. Let's try writing to /Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/slab_with_co2.cif.
